content.short: We provide token dispensing services to the Cardano community.
content.description: An intuitive platform that offers projects a comprehensive selection of distribution parameters. Please go to the DripDropz site under the Drip it tab. Paste your wallet receive/stake address in the search bar and click the Check My Dropz button. DripDropz will query the blockchain and display all the tokens your wallet is qualified to receive based on the amount of Ada in your wallet and the pool it is staked to. Please choose the tokens you wish to receive by selecting the checkboxes. You may select up to 10 tokens per withdrawal.
content.meta: Find out about DripDropz ($DRIP) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
